summary: Implemented the aseprite library under src/aseprite/: little-endian binary I/O, the document model with named lists and layer remapping, a bounded reader and writer covering every chunk type (palettes incl. legacy 4/6-bit, layers, cels incl. linked and tilemap, tilesets, tags, slices, user data, masks, external files, unknown chunks), the Sprite API, Normal-blend and indexed compositing with tilemap flips and isolated groups, and the info/export CLI. Last full-suite run: 260 passed, 0 failed, 48 skipped (editor comparison tests that need the Aseprite binary, which is not installed here).
